movelist.name: Pursuit
movelist.effect: If the foe is fleeing or being switched out, Pursuit may be used as an Interrupt, targeting the triggering foe. When used as an Interrupt, Pursuit grants the user a +5 bonus to all Movement Speeds, and has a Damage Base of 8 (2d8+10 / 19).

movelist.name: Rolling Kick
movelist.effect: Rolling Kick Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Feint
movelist.effect: If a foe uses a Move with the Shield Keyword in response to one of your actions, you may activate Feint to cause the triggering Move to Fail. Feint is activated as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Copycat
movelist.effect: Use the Move the target has used on their last turn. You may choose new targets for the Move. Copycat cannot miss.

movelist.name: Force Palm
movelist.effect: Force Palm Paralyzes the target on 18+.

abilities.name: Technician
abilities.effect: Moves with a Damage Base of 6 or lower have their Damage Base increased by +2. This bonus always applies to Moves with the Double Strike or Fivestrike Keywords.

abilities.name: Copy Master
abilities.effect: Connection - Copycat. Whenever the user uses Copycat or Mimic, it gains +1 Combat Stage in a Stat of its choice after the Move is resolved.
